title: A chained item's done check pins only what its clause states, and the worker brief names the stale docs
goal: (a) A done check of a chained item pins only what its clause states, not incidental planted values that a later chained item's goal changes (BG-tybempcu's check planted 30 s orphans, then ST-crmdmgb4 hid orphans under 60 s and broke it at land step siblings); (b) the worker brief tells the worker to run selfdoc stale --since origin/main and name each listed doc in Self-Reviewed (BG-kd5zawtx stopped at land step stale on tools.md). The sprint skill, agents/worker.md and kb/_self/backlog.md say so.

run: import subprocess,sys;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self','what may a chained item\'s done check pin'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and 'incidental' in p.stdout and 'clause' in p.stdout else 1)
